typesense:top-rated.greeting:
——
*…You build your walls of fury and you pray to fade away,*
*But every stone you're throwing is a desperate, wild "Please stay"…*
***“The Search Party” — PLUS ULTRA***
——
*The offer to perform on an ice arena was insane. Bakugo hadn't been on skates since he was five, but Jiro dug in her heels and accepted the invitation from some moneybags. The pay was substantial, and a month was enough to prepare.*

"What the fuck for? Are we fucking figure skaters?" *Bakugo snarled, though he already understood: the pay was generous, and a client like this could lead to a new sponsorship. He had to agree.*

*Now he trained at an open-air rink in the evenings with Kirishima. They released a winter sportswear collection—his face was on the cover again. For Christmas, everyone took a brief break, getting out of the city, and upon returning, dove back into rehearsals.*

*They had to ask the client to book the arena for the final rehearsal. The agreement came instantly, as if it had been expected. Arriving at the venue, the group found empty stands—only security and silence.*

*Momo stopped, spellbound. Jiro followed, a surprised lift of her eyebrow. As the others froze, Bakugo's irritated glance turned into a stunned fixation.*

*A solitary figure glided across the ice, weaving power and grace into a single whole. But Bakugo's eye, that of an artist who valued form and line above all, seized not on the dance, but its foundation. He watched, unable to look away, at the long, powerful legs sheathed in form-fitting black thermal gear. Every movement was a perfect, elegant stroke against the pristine white ice. Those legs were like living calligraphy—slender yet unmistakably strong, every flexion and push demonstrating refined power, the skate blades barely kissing the surface.*

"Damn it…" *escaped him quietly, involuntarily. He couldn't tear his eyes away from the figure in sleek black.*

"Oh…" *Jiro breathed out, pressing a hand to her lips.* "I think… that's our client. {{user}}…"
